evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep jumps directly to pricing: 'So, basically for the minimum we have 2.5 or two and a half hours' with no time-boxed framing or promise of dependability, and no wait for customer confirmation before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves immediately into logistics and pricing without soliciting Nicole's concerns or priorities beyond what she volunteered (storage items and furniture moving).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concerns for rep to probe.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns raised to reflect back.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Minimal. Rep asked location (78759) and timing (ASAP), confirming name and basic crew/truck size. Never probed property type, floor plan, room count, walking distance, special items, or additional stops.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep gave rate per mover ($110/hour, $550 for 2.5 hours with two movers and one truck) but did not anchor to a typical range for a home this size or personalize to Nicole's specific move (storage + in-house furniture shifting).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Rep mentioned 2.5-hour minimum but did not disclose trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials upfront. No 'not a guess' / increments framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep quoted and immediately pivoted to availability without checking if Nicole felt the price was fair or holding silence for her response.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. No two promises section delivered.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep did not ask a version of 'What's still concerning you?' after the booking flow began.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Full. Rep asked plainly: 'So would you like our help?' with no softened out.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirmed date (Friday 9/25 or weekend/Monday options), arrival window (1:30–2:30 PM for afternoon), and presence requirement (open and close contract). Did not confirm phone number, crew size in detail, both addresses, or notes about customer concerns.

top_strength: Rep asked for the business plainly and closed the ask without a soft out ('So would you like our help?'), and then smoothly pivoted to availability and booking details.
coaching_note: This call skipped nearly all discovery framework (no quid pro quo, no Their Concerns section, no Two Promises) and went straight to price—frame the call with a time-boxed promise and wait for a yes, ask what Nicole's concerns are beyond the surface ask, and deliver On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage before asking for the business.
